change: Add a Bowl or saddle mode to the tangent plane workshop

mutations.name: the xy term is left out of the test
a saddle of opposite signs is told as a twisted one
mutations.find: if(a*b<0) return `a = ${neg(a)} and b = ${neg(b)} have opposite signs
mutations.replace: if(a*b<0 && c===0) return `a = ${neg(a)} and b = ${neg(b)} have opposite signs

mutations.name: a dome is called a bowl
a twisted saddle is not looked for
mutations.find: twists(){ return [0,1,2,3].filter(i=>{ const {a,b}=this.Q(i); return a*b>0 && this.disc(i)<0; }); },

mutations.name: the diagonals are drawn before the round is right
the slice along y uses x²
mutations.find: slices(i){ const {a,b,c}=this.Q(i); return {x:a, y:b, p:a+b+c, m:a+b-c}; },
mutations.replace: slices(i){ const {a,b,c}=this.Q(i); return {x:a, y:a, p:a+b+c, m:a+b-c}; },

mutations.name: a call still moves once the round is right
